$schema_comment: Hooks that automate verification. The harness runs them automatically upon file edits or session stopping.

hooks.description: After editing files, run the test suite to report feedback.

hooks.command: ./.agent/init.sh > /tmp/harness_init.log 2>&1 && echo '[harness] init.sh OK' || (echo '[harness] init.sh FAILED — check /tmp/harness_init.log before closing' && cat /tmp/harness_init.log | tail -20)
hooks.description: Force environment verification checks before terminating the session.
